description:
Where is everyone? Life360 answers that in one glance — the 360 degree app for your whole Circle. Live, real-time location sharing and GPS tracking for the people who matter most — your family, your friends, your Circle. Less worrying, fewer “where r u?” texts.

Accurate location, honestly explained
Life360 uses GPS for accurate, reliable gps location tracking, with smart battery optimizations built in to keep battery use low. For the most reliable positions, keep Wi-Fi on — it improves accuracy significantly, especially indoors. If a location ever looks stale, opening the app refreshes it.

A family locator and phone tracker in one app
See where your kids, partner and parents are on a shared map with real-time location tracking. Get Place Alerts when someone arrives at or leaves home, school or work. Check Location History to see where the day went. Think of it as a location tracker app, a tracker app, and a GPS tracker all rolled into one. But really, it’s just the one your whole family will actually keep installed.

Everyone opts in
Every member of a Circle joins on purpose and can see everyone else — this is a location sharing app built on consent, not surveillance. There’s no hidden tracking and no one watched without knowing. You choose who to share your location with, and you can stop sharing any time you like.

Find your phone, and your stuff
Can Life360 find my phone? As a phone locator and phone number location tracker, yes — lost it down the sofa or left it at work, Life360 helps you find your phone or device fast. Life360’s Tile trackers extend the same idea to pets and the things you lose most — keys, wallets, luggage, bikes.

A good location app and online location app for everyday peace of mind — not just for emergencies, but for the small “are you home yet?” moments too. Whether you need a live location tracking app for a road trip or a location app for daily check-ins, Life360 fits in.

Safety features included with membership
SOS Alerts: send a silent alert with your precise location to your Circle.
Crash Detection: we notice the crash and get help moving.
Flight Landing Notifications and Smart Notifications.

Download Life360 for peace of mind, knowing your loved ones are secure. Join millions who trust Life360 for location sharing.
summary: Family locator & phone tracker: real-time GPS location sharing + SOS
